notes: PROVISIONAL THROUGHOUT. Every entry here was written from provider documentation, not from a recorded payload, so every review_status is 'provisional' and no factor should be built on this table until QNT-031 confirms each field name, statement placement and sign against real captured JSON and promotes the entries to 'verified'. That promotion is the point of the review_status field: an unverified mapping producing plausible numbers is the failure mode this whole ticket exists to prevent. Nothing is mapped on suspicion — an item nobody has checked is simply absent, and normalisation will report it as unmapped rather than guessing.
